ads.name: From a Paddock, Not a Petri Dish
ads.idea: The bold 'real, not lab' poster: one witty positioning line puts Farm Direct on the paddock side, with nobody else named or blamed.
onImageText: From a paddock, not a petri dish.
About 40 places across Australia list beef, lamb, pork or chicken.
ads.primaryText: From a paddock, not a petri dish. About 40 places across Australia list beef, lamb, pork or chicken. Check before you go.
ads.headline: Meat from a paddock, not a petri dish
claims: About 40 places list beef, lamb, pork or chicken: 41 of 106 records.
Across Australia: NSW, VIC, WA, SA, QLD, ACT and TAS (none in the NT), so never say 'every state'.
Free, no account: docs/APP_STORE.md.
'From a paddock, not a petri dish' is a positioning line about Farm Direct, not a claim about anyone else.
ads.recheck: If the meat count falls below about 38, change 'About 40' to 'Dozens of places'.

ads.name: Real Meat. Real Farmers. One Tap.
ads.idea: The defiant line, backed straight away by the one button a shopper presses: the Meat filter.
onImageText: Tap Meat for about 40 places listing beef, lamb, pork or chicken.
ads.primaryText: Real meat. Real farmers. Tap Meat and see about 40 places listing beef, lamb, pork or chicken. Free, no sign-up.
ads.headline: Tap Meat. Find the farmer.
ads.screenshotOptional: shared/screens/02-explore-meat.png (phone is off by default; turn on with data-phone="on" in ad.html once the real Meat-filtered list screen is in place)
claims: The app has a Meat filter covering beef, lamb, pork and chicken: MEAT_CHIP_LABEL in src/components/FilterPanel.tsx and docs/APP_STORE.md.
About 40 places list beef, lamb, pork or chicken: 41 of 106 records.
Free, no sign-up: docs/APP_STORE.md.
'Real meat. Real farmers.' is a positioning line, not a claim about any other product.

ads.name: Meat with a Postcode
ads.idea: Real meat comes from a real place: search a town or postcode, find the nearest places, and ask the farmer the rest.
onImageText: Search a town or postcode for meat. Ask the farmer the rest.
ads.primaryText: Enter a town or postcode to find the nearest of about 40 places listing beef, lamb, pork or chicken. Ask the farmer the rest.
ads.headline: Meat with a postcode
claims: Search by name, town, postcode or produce, and set any suburb or postcode: docs/APP_STORE.md.
Places are sorted by distance, so the app shows the nearest; the copy never says a place is near the viewer.
About 40 places list beef, lamb, pork or chicken: 41 of 106; all 41 have a postcode on record.
'Ask the farmer the rest' invites the shopper to ask; it claims nothing about any farm.

ads.name: Your Weekend Meat Run, Sorted
ads.idea: Turn the Saturday market or farm-shop run into a plan with the real Meat and This weekend filters and an honest, specific number.
onImageText: Nearly 30 places listing meat publish Saturday or Sunday hours.
ads.primaryText: Plan the weekend meat run: turn on Meat and This weekend, check the published hours, get directions. Free, no account.
ads.headline: Weekend meat run, sorted
claims: Meat and This weekend filters exist with those exact labels: src/components/FilterPanel.tsx.
With This weekend on, each place shows this weekend's published times: docs/APP_STORE.md.
Nearly 30: 29 of the 41 meat places have weekly hours with a Saturday or Sunday slot.
Directions open Apple Maps (Apple Maps is not named on the image).
ads.recheck: If the weekend count falls below 28, change 'Nearly 30' to 'About 30' (or recount and reword).

ads.name: Pin It. Drive There. Buy Direct.
ads.idea: The map makes it physical, for road-trippers and caravanners: every place is a pin; tap it for hours and directions, then buy from the farmer.
onImageText: Pin it. Drive there. Buy direct.
About 40 places listing meat, each one pinned on the map.
ads.primaryText: Driving through? About 40 places listing beef, lamb, pork or chicken, each pinned on the map with hours and directions.
ads.headline: Pin it. Drive there. Buy direct.
claims: The map has a pin for every place: docs/APP_STORE.md; all 41 meat places have a latitude and longitude.
About 40 places list beef, lamb, pork or chicken: 41 of 106 (25 farmers' markets, 12 farm shops, 3 farms, 1 farm-gate stall).
Hours or by-appointment details are recorded for all 41.
Directions open Apple Maps: docs/APP_STORE.md.
